assessments.name: Assessment 1: Fieldwork informed analysis & group presentations
assessments.description: Groups will deliver a final group presentation that communicates the context, method of observation, key patterns, and informed recommendations for planning/design responses.

assessments.name: Assessment 2: Reflective Essay
assessments.description: Write a reflective essay exploring individual insights into the value of urban planning and design methods for "Measuring informality and climate adaptation" in Indonesian informal settlements.

assessments.name: Assessment 3: Participation
assessments.description: This assessment will cover attendance at the program's mandatory activities (site visits, cultural tours, daily progress updates, etc.).
